definition: an expert who studies and writes about the past
description: In a ruined stone castle, a bearded man with round glasses, in a tweed jacket and white cotton gloves, holds an old yellowed plan of the building up against the wall beside a brick archway and compares it with the stones. He turns his head from the plan to the wall and breaks into a happy smile. In front of him a folding table holds a laptop, old leather books, a magnifying glass and an open sketchbook with floor plans. Ivy grows over the walls, a crow flies off the top and visitors walk along the path behind.

taps.phrase: to take off from the wall
